label: Overnight
line: Overnight - 95% - Top 20 by 12-month return (adjusted closes); price over $10, $20M a day traded; equal weight; re-ranked every evening on that day's close, bought the next afternoon.
plain: Holds the 20 large US stocks with the highest return over the past 12 months, re-ranked every day (amendment 82c84226; until 2026-10-23: the highest average overnight return, monthly) - bought in the last minutes before the close (3:55-3:59pm New York), sold at the next open by the evening run, every trading day. Replaced SPY momentum (amendment 330e76e0, accepted 2026-10-21). Sits in cash on nights when SPY is below its 200-day average or its picks have fallen 2.0% or more since the open (amendments 7a8b29ec, 9b951502).
screen: Top 20 by 12-month return (adjusted closes); price over $10, $20M a day traded; equal weight; re-ranked every evening on that day's close, bought the next afternoon.
metrics: Fill cost vs the official close/open (break-even about 0.045% per trade; the desk-level case needs about 0.02%). Backtest 2014-2026 at 0.02%: 16.7%/yr, Sharpe 0.81, worst drop -28%.
watch: Costs first: `overnight review`. No crash switch - it stays invested in falling markets (March 2020: -20%).

label: RSI dips
line: RSI dips - 5% - 10% a dip, at most 5; about 5% on average; Top 100 US companies by market value; close above the 200-day average and RSI(14) below 30; lowest RSI first.
plain: Buys one of the 100 largest US companies after a short, sharp fall inside an uptrend: price above its 200-day average with RSI(14) below 30. Each dip is 10% of the desk, bought at the next open and sold at the open after it closes back above its 5-day average (at most 10 trading days); at most 5 at once. About 40 dips a year - most of the time it holds nothing. Amendment c52ce018 (accepted 2026-10-27) replaced the quality screen and momentum sleeves with it.
screen: Top 100 US companies by market value; close above the 200-day average and RSI(14) below 30; lowest RSI first.
metrics: Return per dip after costs. Backtest 2014-2026 (survivors-only): +1.0% a dip in 2014-19 and +1.2% in 2020-26, 11 of 13 years positive; the desk with it and the overnight sleeve: 28.1%/yr, Sharpe 1.78 at 0.02% overnight costs, 15.2%/yr and 0.99 at 0.05%.
watch: Average return per dip after real fills at the open; how often 5 slots are full; dips that keep falling.
